newsitem.title: CUBA: Journalists surprised by Fujimori's trip to Cuba.
newsitem.headline: Journalists surprised by Fujimori's trip to Cuba.

text.p: Journalists accompanying Peru's President Alberto Fujimori on a quick trip to the Dominican Republic were startled on Monday when the plane supposedly taking them home to Lima stopped off in Cuba.

The 30-odd journalists had thought the plane might make a technical stop-over in Colombia, as it had done on the way to the Dominican Republic, where Fujimori held 3-1/2 hours of talks with President Leonel Fernandez on Sunday.
But they landed instead in Havana, where President Fidel Castro, wearing his traditional military dress, received Fujimori with full military honours.
Fujimori's talks with Castro, which began shortly after he landed at mid-morning, were expected to include discussions on Peru's 76-day-old hostage crisis.
